user.title: Sign in with SuperGrok
user.description: Device code is the easiest: approve on any device. Browser sign-in is the backup and asks you to paste an address.

browser.title: Sign in with SuperGrok
browser.description:
1. Open [the sign-in page]({authorize_url}) and approve.

2. The browser then opens `{redirect_uri}` and cannot connect. That is expected.

3. Copy the whole address from the address bar and paste it below.

data_description.callback_url: The address starting with `{redirect_uri}`. The code alone also works.

models.title: Add to Home Assistant
models.description: Pick the chat models, Voice and Imagine to add. You can add more conversation agents later.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Your SuperGrok session expired or was revoked. Sign in again to keep using Grok.

progress.wait_for_authorization:
Open [{url}]({url}) on any device and approve.

If it asks for a code, enter **{user_code}**.

This page continues on its own.

error.missing_code: Paste the whole address. It must contain code=.
error.state_mismatch: That address is from another sign-in. Open the sign-in page again and paste the new address.

abort.already_configured: This SuperGrok account is already configured.
abort.oauth_error: xAI returned an incomplete sign-in response.
abort.access_denied: Access was denied on the xAI page.
abort.wrong_account: That is a different SuperGrok account.
abort.tier_blocked: This account has no SuperGrok or X Premium+ subscription. An xAI API key does not work here.
